adjust_learning_rate_warmup_cosine_decay: adjust the learning rate of an optimizer using warmup followed by half-cycle cosine decay
adjust_learning_rate_param_groups: adjust the learning rate for each optimizer param group with optional lr_scale multiplier
adjust_learning_rate_warmup_phase: adjust the learning rate during warmup epochs by linearly scaling from zero to the target lr
adjust_learning_rate_cosine_phase: adjust the learning rate after warmup using a cosine annealing schedule down to min_lr
adjust_learning_rate_return_lr: adjust the learning rate and return the computed lr value for logging or monitoring
